_about: Live gnomAD gene-list replies with each record's genetic-ancestry groups (populations { id ac an }), captured 2026-11-24 (UTC), keyed '<document>:<dataset>:<gene>'. Each value is the HTTP status and the body, its rows cut to those named here, in gnomAD's order. The gnomad_r4 replies select populations on joint alone, the record that sets a gnomad_r4 row; the others select it on exome, genome, and joint (null on every row there). Every other field is the reply to this server's list document, before gene_id and gene_symbol (#82) were selected, with the FAF @include flags its dataset sets and annotations false.
